feeds.title: C2A Security
feeds.description: C2A Security was founded in 2016 by Michael Dick, previously co-founder of NDS, dedicated to providing the automotive industry with end-to-end in-vehicle cybersecurity protection. Combining multi-disciplinary world-renowned leaders from the automotive, embedded security, and academic domains, C2A created a new approach to In-Vehicle Cybersecurity, bringing car manufacturers a comprehensive, yet practical vehicle security solutions
